proposition: According to Melvin-Koushki, Ibn Turka's own hierarchies in the R. Shaqq-i Qamar and R. Madarij Afham al-Afwaj place philosophers such as Farabi and Suhravardi at low levels short of universal knowledge; this is the same treatise that Corbin's chapter studies.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, author of R. Shaqq-i Qamar; R. Madārij Afhām al-Afwāj
mediation.where: R. Shaqq-i Qamar; R. Madārij Afhām al-Afwāj
mediation.note: A doctrinal work, not addressed to a judge; the duress rule counts a work as evidence of what he held.
We have the work only as MK summarises or translates it; most of the lettrist works are unedited, so MK's paraphrase cannot be checked against a printed text.
